description: #4667 — READ-command differential over the two GROUPED backlink readers, `list_backlinks_grouped` and `list_unlinked_references`. Both answer with a `GroupedBacklinkResponse` (`agaric-store/src/backlink/types.rs`), which the harness projects through `backlink_groups_result` / `backlinkGroupTokens`: one `<page_id>#page_title=…#truncated=…` head per group, one `<page_id>-><block>` per member, and a `filtered#count=…#truncated=…` trailer for the envelope. Four backend decisions are pinned that the mock used to get wrong, each by a seed that exists for it alone: (1) groups are keyed by the source's ROOT page, not its parent — B4 is nested under B3 and still lands in page B2's group (the Rust seed loader used to stamp a nested seed's `page_id` with its parent, where the TS loader resolves the root; this is the first fixture with a nested seed that no op moves, and it reddened the SNAPSHOT leg before the reader was even reached); (2) groups sort alphabetically by `page_title` then `page_id` (`cmp_group`), not by creation — page B5 'Alpha' was created after page B2 'Zulu' and is served first; (3) a source on the target's OWN root page is a self-reference and is excluded from both the groups and the counts — B7 links to B1 from inside B1; (4) pagination is a keyset over GROUPS (`Cursor::for_group`, `v1:{deleted_at,id}`), and the two counts are first-page-only — the backend answers `total_count: 0` / `filtered_count: 0` on a cursor page (#2201 item 1b) and the UI keeps the first page's numbers. The unlinked half pins the FTS needle set: B8 mentions 'Target' in plain text and is the one unlinked reference; B6 mentions it AND links, so it is a backlink, not an unlinked one; and a `pageId` naming a CONTENT block (B3) contributes no title term and answers empty (#4159 item 3). NOT pinned, and deliberately: `filters` and `sort` — both go through the same `applyBacklinkFilters` / `sort_ids` the flat `get_backlinks` path does not exercise either, and the space filter, for the reason `query_backlinks.json` gives. Every linking block is a SEED block edited by an op so its id is byte-identical on both stacks, and the link TOKENS arrive via `edit_block` because the seed insert bypasses the materializer. Derivation in `session-1668`.

blocks.content: plain Target mention without a link

name: query_backlinks_grouped

args.toText: plain Target mention without a link

queries.comment: Two groups, alphabetical: 'Alpha' (page B5, created LAST) before 'Zulu' (page B2). B4 is nested under B3 and is still a member of page B2's group — grouping is by root page. B7 links to B1 from B1's own page and is a self-reference: absent from the groups AND from both counts, which are 3, not 4. Members keep the default `Created { Asc }` order: B3 before B4.
queries.name: grouped_all

queries.comment: `limit` counts GROUPS, not blocks: one group, 'Alpha', `has_more` true, and the minted cursor is `Cursor::for_group` — `page_id` in `id`, `page_title` in the `deleted_at` slot. The first page carries the full counts.
queries.name: grouped_page_1

queries.comment: Resumes on `(page_title, page_id) > cursor`: 'Zulu' with both members, and the listing ends. Both counts are 0 on a cursor page — the backend skips the two COUNT round-trips after the first page (#2201 item 1b) and the UI keeps the first page's numbers; a mock that recounts here diverges from what the app is built against.
queries.name: grouped_page_2

queries.comment: Nothing links to page B5: no groups, and the trailer is the whole answer — both counts 0. It is that trailer, not an `expect_empty`, that keeps an empty grouped answer comparable. Without this step a handler that ignored `blockId` would pass every other one here.
queries.name: grouped_none_for_unlinked_page

queries.comment: The needle is the page title 'Target'. B8 mentions it in plain text and is the one unlinked reference, grouped under its root page 'Zulu'. B6 mentions it AND carries a `[[link]]`, so it is a backlink, not an unlinked one; B7 links from B1's own page; B1's title block is a page and never a candidate. `total_count` is the post-exclusion count: 1.
queries.name: unlinked_all

queries.comment: A `pageId` naming a CONTENT block resolves no title (`block_type = 'page' AND deleted_at IS NULL` guards the lookup, #4159 item 3), so the needle set is empty and only the trailer is recorded — not a search on that block's own text, which links to B1 and would match the resolved title 'Target' in the FTS index.
queries.name: unlinked_none_for_content_block_id
